# theme

Muster theme preference and the Claude theme family poll.

- Spec: `docs/features/theme/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/theme/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/themepoll*.go
go: internal/claudecode/theme*.go
web: web/src/features/theme.ts
web: web/src/theme*.ts
e2e: web/e2e/theme.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/theme.ts
```

## Protocol

- `ws.claude-theme` — `claudeTheme`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred` — The issue dialog ships its disabled primary button with no distinct visual state, like every other button; an app-wide disabled sweep is a backlog item. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue, theme) → `docs/adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-system-font-stacks-only` — Typography uses system font stacks only; no web fonts, no CDN, no vendored font binaries. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: theme) → `docs/adr/stack-system-font-stacks-only.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-aa-contrast-gated-in-check` — Every theme meets WCAG AA for text and non-text UI, hairlines exempt, gated by a contrast script under make check; the one bounded accessibility exception. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-aa-contrast-gated-in-check.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-banner-tokens-not-rose` — The daemon-down banner uses dedicated banner tokens; the rose token stays reserved for the Failed state. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: theme, connection) → `docs/adr/theme-banner-tokens-not-rose.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-claude-theme-read-only-poll` — Claude Code's theme is read, never set: musterd polls one key of Claude's config file read-only and broadcasts a light, dark or unknown family. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, connection) → `docs/adr/theme-claude-theme-read-only-poll.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-contrast-exemptions-button-borders-state-tints` — Fields and the segmented track take a new edge token at the non-text ratio; button borders and state border tints are exempt, each with a reason. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-contrast-exemptions-button-borders-state-tints.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-contrast-floors-above-aa` — Contrast floors rise above AA on every theme, one higher floor for muted and dim text, state hues as text and note tokens; Light moves with the dark themes. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-contrast-floors-above-aa.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose` — Destructive actions use a danger token family; rose stays reserved for the Failed state rather than the rule being amended. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: theme, actions) → `docs/adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-instrument-visual-direction` — Visual direction A, instrument: dark, dense, mono metadata, session state as a coloured rail stripe; the design system is the review checklist. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-instrument-visual-direction.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-pref-enum-follow-not-nullable` — The theme pref is an enum with a follow default, not a nullable; the daemon validates a pattern and treats the value as opaque, the client owns the registry. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, settings) → `docs/adr/theme-pref-enum-follow-not-nullable.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-pref-follows-claude-until-picked` — A Settings dialog offers Follow Claude Code, Instrument, Dark and Light as a theme pref; until the user picks, the dashboard follows Claude Code's family. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, settings) → `docs/adr/theme-pref-follows-claude-until-picked.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-role-named-surface-tokens-hue-named-state` — Surface and text tokens are named by role (bg, fg, well, edge and kin); state tokens keep their hue names because the hue is the semantic. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-role-named-surface-tokens-hue-named-state.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-shell-pip-own-token` — The running-shell pip gets its own token in every theme rather than reusing teal, which is reserved for Working; no exemption is recorded. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: theme, surfaces) → `docs/adr/theme-shell-pip-own-token.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-state-hues-fixed-across-themes` — State colours keep fixed hue families in every theme, tuned per theme for lightness only; the design system's meaning rules carry across palettes. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-state-hues-fixed-across-themes.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-term-split-from-well` — The pane ground token splits from a new well token: the pane follows Claude Code's family, chrome recesses ground on the well, which follows the Muster theme. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-term-split-from-well.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-terminal-ground-follows-claude-family` — The terminal pane ground always follows Claude Code's theme family, override or not; each theme supplies a light and a dark terminal pair. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, surfaces) → `docs/adr/theme-terminal-ground-follows-claude-family.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-three-builtin-themes-instrument-default` — Three built-in themes ship: Instrument, the contrast-fixed default, a conventional dark and a standard light, a palette on the accepted direction. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-three-builtin-themes-instrument-default.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-two-layer-tokens-not-white-label` — Theming is two token layers, semantic tokens over per-theme palette blocks, on one single-user dashboard; a custom theme is a source block, not a file. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-two-layer-tokens-not-white-label.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-type-scale-tokens-15px-root` — A seven-step rem type ramp on a 15px root replaces hardcoded sizes; the terminal is outside the ramp and a user text-size control is deferred. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-type-scale-tokens-15px-root.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/theme-config-key-and-enum` — Claude Code's theme is the global-config key theme with a six-value enum; family is startsWith("light"); default dark. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.258..2.1.267; features: theme) → `docs/facts/theme-config-key-and-enum.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/nongoal-accessibility-i18n-multiuser-other-platforms` — Accessibility, i18n, multi-user and non-macOS platforms are non-goals for a single-user tool; the one bounded exception is the WCAG AA contrast gate. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: theme) → `docs/adr/nongoal-accessibility-i18n-multiuser-other-platforms.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-no-traffic-light-state-palette` — A green, orange and red traffic-light palette for the tile state dot was not adopted; state colours come only from the design system's state tokens. (rejected, 2026-08-29; features: tiles, theme) → `docs/adr/theme-no-traffic-light-state-palette.md`
